planner_json.title: Create test/harness/pins.json (six exact CLI versions, provider/model, credential env names, pins-vs-package.json reconciliation) + JSON schemas (harness-eval-result/v1, HarnessCell/HarnessGrade, InstallationIdentity) + version-lookup resolver with pins_sha256 binding

requirements.title: Twelve-cell summary: every (harness, track) cell present with verdict word and observed CLI version, cursor never omitte
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: A fixture artifact with exactly 12 unique (harness,track) cells, each carrying an observed_cli_version, cursor present with could-not-run — the module exits 0. Mutation fixture (drop the cursor/pinned cell) flips it to 1.

would_fail_if: the recorder emitted fewer than 12 cells or a duplicate (harness, track) pair — the .red drop-cell mutation must be rejected with reason cells-incomplete
any verdict outside pass|fail|could-not-run appeared — vocabulary rejection fires
an absent adapter were omitted instead of present-as-could-not-run — cells|length != 12 fails
pins_sha256 were absent or not 64-hex — identity binding fails

evidence.required_capture: the downloaded artifact file plus its gh api artifact listing line so cell counts are bound to a real run

must_observe: unique harness count prints 6 with cursor in the set
claude-code/pinned checks print exactly: command_list pass, status pass, verify pass, question_before_expensive_work pass
must_not_observe: any empty or null .verdict field
a cursor cell with reason adapter-absent
any of codex/grok/opencode/pi cells with verdict pass
cells|length of 11 or 13, or a duplicate (harness,track) pair

steps: node tests/sprint-01/flow-runner.mjs grd-01 --run latest --mutate drop-cell --expect red

must_observe: exit code non-zero with rejection reason containing "cells-incomplete"
.red file written recording the 11-cell mutated artifact hash
must_not_observe: validator acceptance of the 11-cell result
any write to the downloaded original artifact (0 writes besides the flow report)

scenario.topology_note: GitHub-hosted runner runs harness-eval (12-cell matrix) + grade recorder; local replay downloads harness-eval-result-<run_id>-<attempt> via gh and validates with the recorder's own schema validator

requirements.red_input: Run the same command on base main: gh workflow list shows no harness-eval row, the download 404s, the module exits 1 and writes the .red report — exists today, verified by step 1's before state.
requirements.description: GIVEN seed/live-dispatch-run (RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download) WHEN gh workflow run harness-eval; gh run watch <RUN_ID> until completed; gh run download <RUN_ID> -n harness-eval-result-<RUN_ID>-1 -D /tmp/he1 THEN jq '.cells|length' prints 12; unique harness count prints 6 with cursor in the set; claude-code/pinned checks print exactly: command_list pass, status pass, verify pass, question_before_expensive_work pass; cursor/pinned prints "could-not-run missing-api-key"; pins_sha256 is a 64-character hex string

requirements.title: Hand dispatch: maintainer starts the grade by hand, checkout default, same matrix and checks as nightly
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Dispatch with no inputs creates a run with event workflow_dispatch and install_mode=checkout recorded in the result (same twelve cells, same four checks as the nightly matrix shape) — module exits 0. Explicit published input is accepted and recorded as mode; full published grading resolution lands in sprint-03 by dependency plan (not declined debt).

would_fail_if: a default (no-input) dispatch recorded install_mode published or a release candidate_sha — the checkout identity is omitted
a published dispatch carried checkout identity — R-mode-mixup guard fires
mode were inferred from logs instead of artifact fields

forms: artifact identity fields (event, install_mode, candidate_sha, plugin_revision)
examples: install_mode checkout with candidate_sha == dispatch commit
published input yields install_mode published, candidate_sha null, could-not-run cells naming release resolution
evidence.required_capture: dispatch commit sha from git and the artifact's candidate_sha for equality, plus both run ids

steps: gh workflow run harness-eval with no inputs

must_not_observe: install_mode "published" on a default (no-input) dispatch
candidate_sha null on the checkout run
mode asserted from logs

must_observe: artifact records install_mode "published" and candidate_sha null
cells honestly read "could-not-run" naming release resolution, never checkout-substituted
must_not_observe: candidate_sha == dispatch commit on the published run
a pass verdict on any published-mode cell in sprint-01 (no graded cells exist there)

scenario.topology_note: workflow_dispatch on main with install_mode input (checkout default); artifact records event, install_mode, candidate_sha; a second dispatch with explicit published records published mode without checkout substitution

requirements.red_input: Base main: gh workflow run harness-eval fails with 'could not find any workflows named harness-eval' — the module captures that failure, exits 1, writes .red. Exists today.
